reviews.title: Good Quality
reviews.comment: This fan runs great and is very quiet and definitely keep my cpu in good temps
reviews.author: Awesome game it showed on time was in great condition

reviews.title: Excellent CPU Cooler
reviews.comment: I've been using this cooler for my Home Server and they are quiet enough that my relatives do not hear the PC in the family room. They were not difficult to install using the fan clips. The fan appears to be high quality and sounds the same too. They are black, and go well with a dark build, like mine was.
reviews.author: William

reviews.title: Quiet and cool
reviews.comment: The fan is quiet and amazing. The SE Black model looks amazing behind the glass. I was worried about it fitting in the case but it was no problem. My only complaint is that the thermal paste it came with was dried up and the tube barely had any in it to begin with. Good thing I had a backup thermal paste. For the price and quality of air cooler though I'm not complaining.
reviews.author: SR

reviews.title: Good Value and Performance
reviews.comment: Happy with aesthetics, sound-level, price/performance, packaging and intuitive installation. Please note difficulty may be encountered due to cable clearances and flush fan mounting could be impeded by tall RAM modules, luckily minor for my use case of an NZXT Manta. Provided thermal paste is quite thick, so take care with application.

reviews.title: Great cooler
reviews.comment: Great product, nothing bad to say. Quiet and keeps CPU cool
